lane_title: True Wavenumber-Domain Baranov Pseudogravity Discordance (FFT Poisson integration of RTP magnetics vs observed isostatic gravity)
hypothesis: Hydrothermal alteration along permeable blind faults destroys magnetite (magnetization contrast -> 0 or reversed) while the fault still offsets basement density. A Baranov pseudogravity field computed by wavenumber-domain Poisson integration of the RTP magnetic anomaly (operator 1/|k|) therefore mispredicts the observed isostatic gravity field exactly along demagnetized fault damage zones buried under Quaternary cover, where neither the magnetic nor the gravity field alone carries a strong concordant edge and where air-photo/LiDAR catalogue mapping sees no scarp.
mechanism: 8 zero-catalogue PSGV channels from training_features.tif B02 rtp, B13 iso_grav_anom, B15 depth_to_base_surf: cosine-tapered zero-padded rFFT pseudogravity g_psg = IFFT{ H_hp(k) * RTP_hat(k)/|k| }, global robust regression residual of observed gravity on g_psg, its Hessian crest, tilt-angle phase dislocation |sin(tilt_grav - tilt_psg)|, pseudogravity tilt zero-crossing edge locator weighted by analytic-signal amplitude, log analytic-signal ratio, gradient-direction discordance |sin(dtheta)| between grad(grav) and grad(g_psg), local (sigma=8px) regression-slope deviation, and a basement-depth-gated residual. Added to the validated HGVC specialist heads only (PHYS_DIFF+HGVC-20+PSGV-8 and PHYS-44+HGVC-20+PSGV-8+VIS-23); learner, seeds, allocator (Dinkelbach expected-DTI), collar (>2.5px production), distance-regime budgets and spacings identical to H88-HGVC Exp03 so the paired contrast isolates the PSGV channels.
named_non_fault_mimic: Reversely magnetized Miocene basalt flows (Koenigsberger Q>1) and non-magnetic sedimentary density contrasts: both decouple pseudogravity from observed gravity (pi phase flip / amplitude ratio) along unfaulted mesa rims and lithologic contacts with no brittle offset.

holdout.catalogue_features: every catalogue-derived feature (VIS-23, d_over_w) derived only from fold-visible faults; visible faults masked pixel-exactly in scoring
holdout.promotion_rule: Candidate is selector-eligible only if its pooled overall HOLDOUT-DTI point estimate exceeds 0.202947 AND the in-run paired delta vs the H88-ADHR incumbent exceeds the HGVC margin (+0.008071) or its 95% CI excludes the stored HGVC point; otherwise verdict=negative (research deliverable only). No slot is spent by the agent under any outcome.
